# EnviroServe Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (https://enviroserve.in)

> EnviroServe Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a pioneer in Indian waste management, e-waste recycling, lithium-ion battery recovery, and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) advisory.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **E-Waste Recycling**: Scientific de-manufacturing, CRT/PCB depollution, mechanical shredding, and precious metal extraction under zero-landfill protocols.
- **Li-Ion Battery Recycling**: Closed-loop recovery for Electric Vehicle (EV) power packs, Energy Storage Systems (ESS), and portable lithium batteries, extracting high-purity Black Mass (Lithium, Cobalt, Nickel, Manganese).
- **CPCB EPR Compliance**: Turnkey Extended Producer Responsibility registration, obligation target auditing, physical credit generation, and portal returns for Producers, Importers, and Brand Owners (PIBOs).
- **EPR Categories Covered**: E-Waste, Plastic Packaging (Cat I, II, III, IV), Battery Waste (Rules 2022), Waste Tyres (Pyrolysis/Crumb Rubber), Used Oil (Re-refining), and Multi-Category Portfolios.
- **PRO Services**: Producer Responsibility Organisation take-back systems, consumer awareness drives, and ground-level collection hubs.
- **Reverse Logistics**: Pan-India hazardous-certified transport fleet equipped with GPS tracking, UN-certified packaging, and Form-9 manifest compliance.
- **Asset Liquidation**: Enterprise IT asset disposal with DoD 5220.22-M & NIST 800-88 certified data sanitization and residual value recovery.

- **Collecting Partner (ReTrash)**: Organized doorstep waste & scrap collection network partner providing app-driven pickup scheduling (Google Play) for households, commercial offices, and institutions to channel dry recyclables into EnviroServe's recovery facilities.
